description: Simplified registration scheme primarily for IT and electronic products.

steps.title: Product Testing
steps.description: Submit a sample of your product to any BIS recognized lab. The lab must test it according to the Indian Standard.

steps.title: Test Report Generation
steps.description: Obtain the official test report from the BIS recognized laboratory. This report is valid for 90 days.

steps.title: Online Registration
steps.description: Create an account on the CRS portal, fill in the product details, and upload the test report along with brand authorization and business licenses.

steps.title: Affidavit & Undertaking
steps.description: Submit the physical or digitally signed affidavit and undertaking as prescribed by BIS.

steps.title: Grant of Registration
steps.description: BIS scrutinizes the application and test report. Upon approval, a Registration Number is granted which must be displayed on the product (Standard Mark).
